<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

<https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083>
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:deactivated false ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    rdfs:label "IMO-083 Polar Code 9.3.2.1.3 antenna ice accumulation prevention"@en ;
    dcterms:identifier "IMO-083" ;
    dcterms:source "International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code), clause 9.3.2.1.3: For ships operating in areas and during periods where ice accretion is likely to occur, means to prevent the accumulation of ice on antennas required for navigation and communication shall be provided."@en ;
    dcterms:source "Source document data/requirements/IMO_full.txt sha256 27ffb65eeae2519755523f40105ea0611d4f8238f15dddb7b465b9241ba32553; retained selection start 0 end 143581; source_selection manifest sha256 6155e4264db2a88d2f4f0da7637f2d8da2a20bf0ad1810fc3b4654aceda60741."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Targeting uses the caller-admitted owner class nltl:ship. External Polar Code eligibility, source-edition choice, and population completeness are caller admissions, not re-certified here. The regulatory condition inside the represented requirement remains active: the prevention obligation is evaluated only where nltl:iceAccretionLikely is true."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Material representation note: supplied terms nltl:iceAccumulationPreventionMeansPresent and nltl:requiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna have unresolved ownership in the supplied contract and are not used to invent a ship-level owner binding. This shape uses the resolved path nltl:hasRequiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna from nltl:ship to nltl:navigationOrCommunicationAntenna and the antenna-owned boolean nltl:antennaIceAccumulationPreventionPresent."@en ;
    sh:property <https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083/IceAccretionLikelyInput> ;
    sh:property <https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083/RequiredAntennaPathValues> ;
    sh:sparql <https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083/ApplicableAntennaPreventionConstraint> .

<https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083/IceAccretionLikelyInput>
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:deactivated false ;
    sh:path nltl:iceAccretionLikely ;
    sh:minCount 1 ;
    sh:maxCount 1 ;
    sh:datatype xsd:boolean ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    sh:message "IMO-083 applicability cannot be determined unless the ship has exactly one xsd:boolean nltl:iceAccretionLikely value. Absence is not treated as evidence that ice accretion is unlikely."@en .

<https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083/RequiredAntennaPathValues>
    a sh:PropertyShape ;
    sh:deactivated false ;
    sh:path nltl:hasRequiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna ;
    sh:class nltl:navigationOrCommunicationAntenna ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    sh:message "Each represented value of nltl:hasRequiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna must be a nltl:navigationOrCommunicationAntenna. IMO-083 does not itself invent missing antenna inventory entries."@en .

<https://w3id.org/nltl/shapes/IMO-083/ApplicableAntennaPreventionConstraint>
    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
    sh:deactivated false ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    sh:message "IMO-083 / Polar Code 9.3.2.1.3: where nltl:iceAccretionLikely is true, every represented antenna linked by nltl:hasRequiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna must have nltl:antennaIceAccumulationPreventionPresent true. A missing, false, non-boolean, or otherwise non-true represented value is not accepted."@en ;
    sh:select """
        PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>

        SELECT $this ?antenna ?value
        WHERE {
            $this nltl:iceAccretionLikely true ;
                  nltl:hasRequiredNavigationOrCommunicationAntenna ?antenna .

            OPTIONAL {
                ?antenna nltl:antennaIceAccumulationPreventionPresent ?value .
            }

            FILTER ( !BOUND(?value) || ?value != true )
        }
        """ .
<END_SHACL>
